title: What Do You Do at the Weekend?

lines.text: Hi Jack! What do you do at the weekend?
On Saturdays I play football with my cousins. And you?
I often go to the cinema with my sister in the afternoon.
Cool. What about Sundays?
On Sundays, we visit my grandma. She cooks a big lunch.
Nice! I stay at home on Sundays. I read and play video games.
Do you want to come to the cinema next Saturday?
Sorry, I can't. I have football. But I'm free on Sunday afternoon.
OK! Let's go to the cinema on Sunday.
Great. See you then!
